field_audits.exact_text:
FinishState has no explicit declaration. Its first mention is PlantUML line 21: `cruise --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` inside the HighwayMode block, so PlantUML declares it as a child of HighwayMode. It is also used from outside that block: PlantUML line 38: `lane_change_urban --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<0.7`; PlantUML line 46: `UrbanMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true`. In the closed model those transitions enter HighwayMode and are routed to its child FinishState.

Consequences observed in the same closed model (folded sub-claims, each an obligation settled by this root cause): (1) HighwayMode termination at FinishState is not stable: FinishState re-enters itself via auto_finished_true cycle: FinishState (state:FinishState:line:22) has an outgoing transition on auto_finished_true (transition:line:36: FinishState -> [*], effect R45RouteToken=20). This exits HighwayMode, which then re-enters via the self-loop HighwayMode -> HighwayMode guarded by R45RouteToken==20 (transition:line:65), triggering the conditional initial entry [*] -> FinishState guarded by R45RouteToken==20 (transition:line:24). This creates an infinite cycle: FinishState -> exit -> re-enter HighwayMode -> FinishState.
